requirements.approved_text: NTFS, ReFS, FAT32 and exFAT are within scope; capability uncertainty is explicitly downgraded or rejected.
requirements.validation_status: requires_current_run_evidence; test paths are not pass claims
requirements.scope_note: Capability coverage is not equivalent physical overwrite: ReFS and special formats require explicit delete-only approval; unknown storage is rejected.

requirements.approved_text: Do not follow symbolic links or junctions; never overwrite shared hard-link data.
requirements.scope_note: Reparse ancestors and final components are rejected; shared hard-link data is never overwritten.

requirements.approved_text: Protect Windows, boot, recovery, system-service resources and important filesystem metadata.
Attempt graceful lock release first; each forced process termination requires separate confirmation.
Select the best-effort strategy from actual storage-media and filesystem capabilities.
Process every accessible alternate data stream; report stream enumeration/access failures explicitly.
Default to one pass of cryptographically secure pseudorandom overwrite data.
Flush then read back all overwritten bytes and compare against the exact expected stream.
Use the native Windows TRIM path when applicable; never equate acceptance with physical sanitization.
Stop the affected operation on failure and retain truthful partial state.
Process a batch per file, skip failed items, and remove directories only when empty.
Maximize speed only within unchanged safety and complete-verification guarantees.
Assess synchronous/overlapped I/O, caching and alignment according to the device.
requirements.scope_note: Buffered write-through I/O, positioned overlapped SSD operations and synchronous HDD/USB operations; no unaligned FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING path is claimed.

requirements.approved_text: Group work by physical storage device and dynamically bound each device's concurrency.
Use bounded buffers and allow a configurable global memory ceiling.
requirements.scope_note: Budget constrains engine working memory and buffers; allocator, GUI, OS cache and driver memory are not a process RSS hard limit. Metadata also has explicit count/text bounds.

requirements.approved_text: Choose overwrite block size from device characteristics, alignment and measurements.
requirements.scope_note: Transfer latency drives bounded chunk adaptation; hardware throughput tuning remains unmeasured.

requirements.approved_text: Support pause, cancel and durable checkpoints; revalidate target identity before resume.
Dynamically limit CPU, I/O and queued work according to system load.
requirements.scope_note: CPU/RAM pressure, per-device queues and shared bandwidth limiter; system-global scheduling control is not claimed.

requirements.approved_text: Use Dear ImGui, Win32 and DirectX 11 in a single native GUI window.
Ship distinct GUI and CLI executables backed by the same core library.
Preview every frozen target, size and risk before confirming the whole batch.
CLI defaults to preview and requires an explicit irreversible-operation confirmation argument.
GUI supports drag/drop, file/directory pickers, queue, pause, cancel, resume and history.
Show file/batch progress, throughput, ETA, failure counts and device statistics.
Emit JSONL with stable event codes, Win32/NTSTATUS context and path masking.
requirements.scope_note: Win32 APIs report native Win32 codes; VSS reports HRESULT. No NTSTATUS is fabricated for APIs that do not expose it.

requirements.approved_text: Use a currently supported MSVC toolchain discovered in VS2022 or VS2026 installations.
Prefer Ninja/CMake and verified C++ named modules.
requirements.scope_note: RC2 owns all public declarations in13 genuine named modules; two private engine partitions encapsulate admission/execution. Every authored C++ unit imports the actual vendor std module. CMake FILE_SET scanning builds real BMIs; no textual owned API or fake std fallback. Portable Clang21 C++26 module evidence is separate from pending native MSVC evidence.

requirements.approved_text: Use /std:c++latest; rely only on compiler/library facilities demonstrated to work.
requirements.scope_note: MSVC uses actual /std:c++latest. CMake4.4.4 identifies this installed MSVC standard-library mode with standard metadata23; it does not provide an MSVC standard26 mapping. Portable verification uses genuine Clang21 -std=c++26 and libc++ std.cppm. No compiler feature claim follows from a version label alone.

requirements.approved_text: Release only with /O2 /GL /LTCG /MT; enable PGO only after supported testing.
requirements.scope_note: PGO remains off until a measured training/validation run exists.

requirements.approved_text: Maintain x64 baseline compatibility and dispatch CPU-specific operations at runtime.
requirements.scope_note: Portable scalar x64 baseline plus Windows CNG system entropy; no unsupported AVX baseline or untested custom SIMD dispatch.

requirements.approved_text: BAT/CMake automatically discover PATH tools first, then regular MSVC/SDK/tool installation paths.
Pin dependency versions and hashes and support cached/offline rebuilds.
Use UTF-8 BOM for authored source; honor standard-format UTF-8 exceptions; deliver Source ZIP.
Validate Windows 10 1809 and representative Windows 10/11 builds; distinguish expected from tested support.
requirements.scope_note: All requested Windows versions are expected targets until actual OS build evidence is supplied.

requirements.approved_text: Maintain a filesystem and HDD/SSD/USB capability/test matrix; downgrade or reject unsupported cases.
requirements.scope_note: Virtual, remote, unknown and multi-disk volume topologies currently fail closed. Physical HDD/SSD/USB tests remain required.

requirements.approved_text: Grade outcomes by verifiable evidence, residual risks and incomplete operations.
Run fault and destructive tests only on dedicated test data/VMs/disposable media.
System-resource protection is fail-closed: uncertainty rejects the target.
Release needs all required tests passing; incomplete platform compatibility validation permits only RC.
requirements.scope_note: This candidate is source RC only, not a tested native binary or Release. Missing native evidence stays not_run.

requirements.approved_text: Deliver source ZIP, build scripts, locked dependencies, tests and machine-readable acceptance evidence.
Revalidate handles, volume/file identity and attributes; reject inconsistent targets.
Before resume, validate identity, size, streams, timestamps and checkpoint state.
Temporarily adjust attributes only on approved non-system targets and restore them where possible.
requirements.scope_note: Readonly adjustment/restoration is handle-bound and checkpoint snapshots restore attributes before persistence; Windows runtime evidence pending.

requirements.approved_text: Deduplicate by identity and do not overwrite hard-link shared data.
requirements.scope_note: Multiple selected aliases collapse to one deterministic namespace. Remaining aliases survive, are reported, and can leave selected directories nonempty.

requirements.approved_text: Analyze special-file capabilities, then choose overwrite, explicitly authorized downgrade deletion, or refusal with evidence.
On storage-device or filesystem fault, stop affected device work and retain isolated diagnostics.
Overwrite/verify accessible resident data streams; report historical MFT/journal remnants as unguaranteed.
requirements.scope_note: Logical accessible resident streams are covered; historical filesystem records and journal entries are not sanitized.

requirements.approved_text: Use versioned built-in protection rules plus runtime identification; reject unknown protection status.
Force-terminate only clearly identified, unprotected user processes, with confirmation for each process.
Checkpoint storage requires integrity, restricted access, atomic updates and version compatibility.
requirements.scope_note: DPAPI provides authenticated protection, not anti-rollback against the same principal/SYSTEM. Fresh consent, identity checks and content verification still apply.

requirements.approved_text: Downgrade deletion needs extra confirmation, including a separate CLI authorization.
Do not modify snapshots or backups; detect identifiable retained-copy risks and report them.
requirements.scope_note: Read-only completed VSS snapshot inventory is explicit complete/count/error; provider failure is unknown, not zero. Arbitrary/offline/cloud backups cannot be inventoried completely.

requirements.approved_text: Freeze the target set during preview; revalidate identity at execution; never process additions or replacements.
List downgrade targets and obtain independent preview authorization; reconfirm changed execution capabilities.
requirements.scope_note: Execution capability changes reject the old approval and require repreview/fresh explicit consent; no silent downgrade.

requirements.approved_text: Use a bounded reproducible cryptographic data stream; protect sensitive state and verify its integrity.
Restrict log/checkpoint access, allow configurable retention, remove completed checkpoints and rotate logs by policy.
requirements.scope_note: Default incomplete checkpoint retention is unlimited until completion/explicit expiry; logs default30days,4MiB x8. ACL is not a boundary against a compromised same user/SYSTEM.

requirements.approved_text: All necessary unit/integration/isolated destructive tests must pass; without platform measurements deliver at most RC.
requirements.scope_note: Unit/portable integration evidence is generated locally; mandatory native isolated and media matrix tests remain owner-run gates.

current_validation_location: CI artifacts and release evidence, never a tracked per-run report
